observations.text: Compare with previous on two plain-text Versions opened the comparison page with 'Comparison failed' and 'Version 1 does not support extracted text.'; no Version was added. This matches compare-versions.md (download-only or non-extractable formats cannot supply text) and does not affect the reference's Comparison row.

The Portal Request an API key dialog offered a Business User the full Toolset ceiling, including Administration and Team. The reference says the request names Toolsets 'from the organization's ceiling', which matches. Whether Business Users should see Administration there is a product question for the mcp group, not a guide failure.

Settings > Advanced > File uploads lets an Administrator save a Maximum file size (MiB) that replaces the default after an API and worker restart; a value set in the deployment configuration is read only there. The reference names only MAX_UPLOAD_MB and says to use the actual refusal or ask the operator; the troubleshooting guide asks for 'an operator-approved limit change'. Both statements hold; the author may want to mention the Administrator setting.
